syllabusSource.title: Pharmacy Council of India, M.Pharm syllabus: MRM 301T Research Methodology and Biostatistics, semester III course common to all specializations (also in the Gazette of India M.Pharm syllabus, 11 August 2026)

units.title: General research methodology: objectives, literature review, study designs, bias, controls, randomization, crossover design, placebo and blinding
Biostatistics: sample size, tests of significance, parametric and non-parametric tests, null hypothesis, P values and degrees of freedom
Medical research and medical ethics: values, informed consent, confidentiality, euthanasia, ethics committees and professional conduct
CPCSEA guidelines for laboratory animal facility
Declaration of Helsinki: history, basic principles and principles for research combined with medical care
